title: MPK Qwen3 8B Persistent Decode-1024 H200 Capture
command: Tree-sync standalone pto-cu to bizhaoh200, run native torch control and MPK persistent Qwen/Qwen3-8B demo on CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 with offline Hugging Face cache, max_seq_length=1063, max_num_batched_requests=1, max_num_batched_tokens=1, ignore_eos, and temperature=0, then normalize the token artifacts with mpk_qwen3_persistent_capture.py.
observation: Native torch control and MPK persistent decode both exited with status 0. The persistent run generated 1024 tokens for a 39-token prompt and wrote decoded text plus predecode debug output. The MPK demo reports one combined prefill+decode per-token timing around asynchronous persistent-kernel launch, so the imported viewer row is execution coverage with an explicit latency caveat rather than a final repeated latency distribution.

summary.latency_scope: single combined prefill+decode per-token MPK demo timing; asynchronous persistent-kernel launch caveat
remaining_paper_gaps: repeat MPK Qwen3-8B serving rows across the full batch ladder if final latency distributions are claimed
align MPK serving rows with matching PTO persistent-device, VDCores, vLLM, SGLang, and ThunderKittens serving-policy evidence
